kebab_example: aliyun aiccs create-ai-call-task --task-name '测试任务' --agent-id 118000000000000000 --virtual-number 03271212200000 --start-type SCHEDULE --miss-call-retry false --call-retry-reason CALL_REJECTED --call-retry-times 2 --call-retry-interval 32 --call-time {"startTime":"09:00:00","endTime":"10:00:00"} --callable-time example-string --call-day MONDAY --task-start-time 12313123133 --task-cps 75 --source 0 --application-code 0250000C98 --phone-type 0 --line-encoding JILIANG_000_000_NET --line-phone-num 15200003120 --call-expire-type 0 --call-expire-minutes 10 --call-expire-date 2026-07-30_20:00:20 --api-version 2019-10-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAiCallTask

parameters.help_en: The task name. The name must be unique within the same account
parameters.help_zh: 任务名称，同一个账号下不允许重复
parameters.name: task_name

parameters.help_en: The code of the agent that is already online
parameters.help_zh: 已上线的智能体编码
parameters.name: agent_id

parameters.help_en: The service instance used for outbound calls
parameters.help_zh: 呼出使用的服务实例
parameters.name: virtual_number

parameters.help_en:
The start mode. Valid values:

IMMEDIATE: starts immediately.

SCHEDULE: starts at a scheduled time
parameters.help_zh:
启动方式。取值：

IMMEDIATE：立即启动。

SCHEDULE：定时启动
parameters.name: start_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable retry. Valid values:

true: enabled.

false (default): disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启重试。取值：

true：是。

false（默认）：否
parameters.name: miss_call_retry

parameters.help_en: The list of failure retry reasons
parameters.help_zh: 失败重试原因列表
parameters.name: call_retry_reason

parameters.help_en: The number of retries. The maximum value is 3
parameters.help_zh: 重试次数，最大不能超过3次
parameters.name: call_retry_times

parameters.help_en: The retry interval. Unit: minutes. The maximum value is 720 minutes
parameters.help_zh: 重试间隔，单位：分钟，最大不能超过720分钟
parameters.name: call_retry_interval

parameters.help_en: The list of callable time periods
parameters.help_zh: 可呼叫时间段列表
parameters.name: call_time

parameters.help_en: The CallableTime
parameters.help_zh: The CallableTime
parameters.name: callable_time

parameters.help_en: The list of callable days
parameters.help_zh: 可呼叫日列表
parameters.name: call_day

parameters.help_en: The preset start time of the task. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. This parameter is valid and required when the StartType parameter is set to SCHEDULE. The task automatically starts at the time specified by this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 任务预设的启动时间，时间戳，单位毫秒。StarType字段为SCHEDULE时该字段有效且必填，任务将在该字段设置的时间进行自动启动
parameters.name: task_start_time

parameters.help_en: The task concurrency. The maximum value is 500
parameters.help_zh: 任务并发，最大不超过500
parameters.name: task_cps

parameters.help_en:
The creation source. Valid values:

0: created by agent.

1: created by engine
parameters.help_zh:
创建来源：取值

0：智能体创建

1：引擎创建
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en: The application code. This parameter is used when the creation source is engine
parameters.help_zh: 应用code，创建来源为引擎创建时使用
parameters.name: application_code

parameters.help_en:
The number type. This parameter is used when the creation source is engine. Valid values:

0: Alibaba Cloud number.

1: customer-provided line
parameters.help_zh:
号码类型（创建来源为引擎创建时使用）

0：阿里云号码

1：客户自带线路
parameters.name: phone_type

parameters.help_en: The line encoding
parameters.help_zh: 线路编码
parameters.name: line_encoding

parameters.help_en: The customer-provided line number
parameters.help_zh: 自带线路号码
parameters.name: line_phone_num

parameters.help_en:
The outbound call validity type. Valid values:

0: permanently valid.
1: valid for a specified duration after import.
2: valid until a specified date
parameters.help_zh:
外呼有效期类型：

0：长期有效；
1：导入后一段时间内有效；
2：截止指定时间有效；
parameters.name: call_expire_type

parameters.help_en: The expiration duration of outbound call details. Unit: minutes
parameters.help_zh: 外呼明细过期时长（分钟）
parameters.name: call_expire_minutes

parameters.help_en: The expiration date of outbound call details (specific deadline)
parameters.help_zh: 外呼明细过期日期（具体截止时间）
parameters.name: call_expire_date
